Gas just fell below $4. Oil supply finally tops demand.
AAA: the national average slipped under $4 on Nov 10, 2026, for the first time since July, and hit $3.90 by Nov 12. A month ago it was $4.36; a year ago about $3.08.
On Nov 13, the International Energy Agency said global oil supply is topping demand for the first time since the Iran war began. Observed global stockpiles rose 52 million barrels in October, the first build since June.
Our math: at $3.90, a 15-gallon fill-up cost $6.90 less than a month earlier, but gas is still 82 cents a gallon above last year.
Sources: AAA (Nov 12, 2026); IEA Oil Market Report (Nov 13, 2026); Quartz; The National.
News and education, not financial advice.
